params.name: Sound
params.desc: Selects the sound within the current bank

params.name: Tune
params.desc: Adjusts pitch tuning of the selected track

params.name: Tone
params.desc: Function varies by sound bank (LPF/HPF on general drums; snappy volume on SD; sub-oscillator octave on bass)

params.name: Move
params.desc: Function varies by sound bank (modulation time on BD; nudge on SD/general; decay curve on SY/BS; slope on samples; glide time on bass)

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Attack time or start position depending on track type

params.name: Decay
params.desc: Decay time or length depending on track type

params.name: Reverb send
params.desc: Send level to reverb effect. At 0 no signal is sent to the reverb.

params.name: Delay send
params.desc: Send level to delay effect. At 0 no signal is sent to the delay.

params.name: Pan
params.desc: Track pan position. L63 through Center to R63.

params.name: Level
params.desc: Track volume from -infinity to +6 dB. 0 dB at values 63-64.

params.name: Random velocity
params.desc: Amount of per-step velocity randomization. Maximum depth varies by sound bank.

params.name: Mute
params.desc: Mutes or unmutes the track

params.name: Sound bank
params.desc: Selects the sound bank for the track

params.name: Accent hard
params.desc: Adjusts hard accent depth for drum tracks

params.name: Accent soft
params.desc: Adjusts soft accent depth for drum tracks

params.name: Accent hard
params.desc: Adjusts hard accent depth for sample tracks

params.name: Accent soft
params.desc: Adjusts soft accent depth for sample tracks

params.name: Repitch
params.desc: Enables repitch so sample pitch follows tempo changes

params.name: Accent
params.desc: Adjusts accent depth for the stereo sample track

params.name: Filter cutoff
params.desc: Adjusts the filter cutoff frequency

params.name: Filter resonance
params.desc: Adjusts the amount of filter resonance

params.name: Filter envelope depth
params.desc: Adjusts the amount of filter envelope modulation

params.name: Filter envelope decay
params.desc: Adjusts the filter envelope decay time

params.name: Accent
params.desc: Adjusts the accent amount of the bass track

params.name: Drive
params.desc: Adjusts the bass drive amount. Only active when overdrive is enabled.

params.name: Level
params.desc: Adjusts the bass track level

params.name: Drive bypass
params.desc: Toggles bass overdrive on or off

params.name: Glide curve
params.desc: Adjusts the glide curve shape. At 0 the curve is downward (exponential). Higher values produce a more linear curve.

params.name: Octave
params.desc: Shifts the keyboard octave range up to plus or minus 3 octaves

params.name: Swing
params.desc: Adjusts the swing amount from 50 to 75 percent

params.name: Swing resolution
params.desc: Sets the swing resolution to 8th or 16th notes

params.name: Isolator low
params.desc: 3-band isolator low band (20-400 Hz). Cuts or boosts from -infinity to +6 dB.

params.name: Isolator mid
params.desc: 3-band isolator mid band (400-1500 Hz). Cuts or boosts from -infinity to +6 dB.

params.name: Isolator high
params.desc: 3-band isolator high band (1500-20000 Hz). Cuts or boosts from -infinity to +6 dB.

params.name: Reverb type
params.desc: Selects the reverb type

params.name: Reverb
params.desc: Adjusts the reverb mix level. At 0 the reverb is muted.

params.name: Delay mix
params.desc: Adjusts the delay mix level. At 0 the delay is muted.

params.name: Delay time
params.desc: Adjusts the delay time

params.name: Delay feedback
params.desc: Adjusts the delay feedback amount

params.name: Delay ping pong
params.desc: Toggles delay ping-pong mode on or off

params.name: Delay sync
params.desc: Toggles delay tempo sync on or off

params.name: Delay to reverb
params.desc: Send level from delay output to reverb

params.name: Master effect bypass
params.desc: Toggles the master effect on or off. On/off state is not saved.

params.name: Master effect type
params.desc: Selects the master effect type. Type and parameter are saved globally.

params.name: Master effect parameter
params.desc: Adjusts the master effect parameter. Function varies by effect type.

params.name: Pattern swing
params.desc: Adjusts the pattern-level swing amount from 50 to 75 percent

params.name: Pattern swing resolution
params.desc: Sets the pattern-level swing resolution to 8th or 16th notes

params.name: Feel
params.desc: Selects the analog feel type that simulates vintage drum machine rhythmic fluctuations

params.name: Pattern level
params.desc: Adjusts the overall pattern volume from -infinity to +6 dB
